skillBaseDescription: Unbridled ferocity honed into an unstoppable warrior.

Kurn berserkers would lull their enemies into a false sense of confidence by engaging in a series of feints before unleashing a devastating well-timed blow. ^oWhen used as your default weapon attack, Onslaught generates stacks. Your next activated cooldown attack will consume all stacks to deal additional damage.

Kurn berserkers blessed with Mogdrogen's gift were some of the most terrifying troops fielded in their ancient war with Erulan. To this day, tales of these warriors paint the Kurn as savage bloodthirsty monsters. With Mogdrogen's gift, you assume the form of the werewolf, gaining new bonuses and abilities for as long as the transformation persists. ^oWerewolf form has its own basic attack and cannot trigger weapon pool skills.
The corrupted blood of Ch'thon has taken hold within you, twisting your transformation into a ravenous abomination bent on destruction.
You swipe at your foes with savage claws, cutting through their ranks.
You rip and tear through your foes in a straight line, tossing the weak aside as the fodder they are.
To a trained berserker, there is no greater thrill than the glory of combat. As you land ^ocritical blows^h, you feel invigorated.
